messages:
mike: Heads-up — need to push a prod hotfix at 17:30 PT for the cache invalidation bug. Before we start, can we confirm prod deploy permissions + MFA for whoever triggers. deploy-bot will enforce gating.

sara: I’m oncall and available. My MFA is Yubi. Do we need another approver? I thought only release-managers could push these days.

ana: Policy changed last week — SRE + Releases + eng-leads are allowed. For temporary grants we use the /grant-deploy flow (requires 2 approvers). If this is a true hotfix we can do a short-lived grant.

mike: This is urgent, but small. Also want to pin the image to sha to make rollback straightforward.

deploy-bot: Incoming deploy request detected. Permission check: mike -> NOT AUTHORIZED. Allowed groups: prod-deployers, release-managers. To request temporary access run: `/grant-deploy @mike --expires 6h` (2 approvers required).

jordan: I’m OOO this afternoon. @sara @ana can one of you approve the grant if needed?

sara: I can approve — doing it now. Also request: pin to v1.4.3-sha:abcdef and disable new-provider flag during rollout.

ana: Approved. Confirm pin: image sha=abcdef. Rollback target = v1.4.2-sha:123456. Release notes: "hotfix - cache TTL bug leading to stale reads". I'll add the feature-flag toggle to the deploy task.

mike: Thanks. I’ll update release notes and add the sha to the deploy command.

infra-sre-bot: Audit: last elevated role change for @mike was 1798400000 by @ops-admin. Temporary grant requested: /grant-deploy @mike --expires 6h (pending approvals)

ops-admin: Confirming I initiated the role change last week for the support rotation.

sara: Approved the grant. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Temporary deploy grant issued to mike, expires in 6h. Proceeding when you call /deploy.

sara: I’ll kick the deployment to keep audit trail under release-managers. Running `/deploy prod v1.4.3-hotfix --image-sha=abcdef --disable-flag=new-provider`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sara. Timeline: init -> migrate -> rollout. ETA ~6m. Logs: https://internal.logs/release/1798504327

mike: Monitoring metrics — initial traffic looks stable. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Rollout 100% after 4m. Deploy succeeded. To rollback: `/rollback prod --image-sha=123456` or use the abort channel within 10m.

ana: Nice. Created a short runbook entry: docs/releases/hotfix-2026-03-20.md. I also noted the feature-flag toggle and verification steps.

mike: Filed follow-up to add mike to read-only deploy observers group so he can watch without getting permanent deploy rights.

sara: Can we schedule a quick review tomorrow to clean up ad-hoc grants? Prefer more long-term role clarity rather than frequent temp grants.

mike: Agreed — opening a ticket for deploy role audit and proposed changes to the /grant-deploy flow.

jordan: Thanks folks. Good work. :thumbsup:
